Bare-Metal FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

What is a Bare-Metal Dedicated Server?

A bare-metal dedicated server is a single-tenant physical server where 100% of the hardware resources (CPU, RAM, NVMe storage, network controllers) are dedicated exclusively to your organization. Unlike virtual servers, there is zero hypervisor overhead, noisy neighbor penalty, or shared resource contention.

How fast is server provisioning?

Standard hardware configurations (AMD EPYC, Ryzen 9, Xeon Gold) are provisioned automatically via PXE within 15 to 30 minutes after order confirmation. Custom hardware modifications or multi-drive RAID arrays are assembled and online in under 4 hours.

Do I get full IPMI / KVM out-of-band access?

Yes! Every dedicated server comes standard with a dedicated out-of-band IPMI / iDRAC / KVM interface. You can remotely power cycle, reboot, mount custom ISO files, and access the BIOS at any time directly through our Client Portal.

What is your hardware replacement SLA?

We provide a guaranteed 1-hour hardware replacement SLA. In the rare event of a physical RAM or disk degradation, our enterprise datacenter technicians replace the failed component within 60 minutes 24/7/365.

Can I announce my own IP address subnets (BGP / BYOIP)?

Absolutely. We support custom BGP session setups, cross-connects, and BYOIP (/24 or larger IPv4 subnets and IPv6 blocks) with automated RPKI validation across our global routing locations.
